claim: The actual base-preserving complex-valued points of ProjectiveJLine318.scheme Q, with original algebraic-evaluation topology and inverse charts, are biholomorphic to the independent sphere and hence to the unchanged original compact level-three source, with exact parameter and cusp evaluation identities.

obligations.name: Actual points and fixed coefficient map
obligations.required_input: Base-preserving morphisms from Spec(C) to the exact original Proj over Q, with no arbitrary coefficient-field map.
obligations.constructed_input: Points is the subtype of actual scheme morphisms satisfying the original structure-map equation; chartPoint is literal polynomial evaluation followed by JLineAtlas318.chart.
obligations.justification: The equality over Spec(R) is carried as a field of Points. Every factored morphism is converted using Spec.homEquivAlgHom, so polynomial algebra-hom extensionality identifies its coordinate without forgetting the coefficient map.

obligations.name: Coverage on all scheme-valued points
obligations.required_input: Every field-valued morphism, including infinity, must factor through one of the actual two affine charts.
obligations.constructed_input: point_factors_chart uses the original open cover and the singleton field spectrum; every_point_in_chart recovers an actual evaluation coordinate.
obligations.justification: The image of the entire field spectrum lies in the selected chart because that spectrum is a subsingleton. IsOpenImmersion.lift factors the morphism itself. This is not merely coverage of closed geometric points or generic parameters.

obligations.name: Exact algebraic reciprocal transition and exceptional point
obligations.required_input: Reciprocal transition on exactly the invertible-coordinate overlap and a genuinely distinct infinity point.
obligations.constructed_input: unit_overlap is the same scheme-morphism equality as JLineOverlap318.unit_chart_overlap; chart_zero_preimage_one is the original basic open X≠0. Infinity has empty preimage in the finite chart.
obligations.justification: For any field coordinate, zero in chart 0 is the infinity point; every nonzero coordinate there converts by a unit to chart 1 at its reciprocal. Finite chart injectivity and disjointness from infinity prove pointMap bijective on every point, with no cardinality shortcut.

obligations.name: Independent complex topology
obligations.required_input: The topology on actual scheme-valued points must arise from original algebraic charts, not from the modular comparison.
obligations.constructed_input: complexPointTopology is coinduced from the disjoint union of the two original algebraic evaluation maps. sphereCover is the independent finite/reciprocal sphere cover.
obligations.justification: sphereCover is continuous, open and surjective. pointMap_sphereCover identifies the two cover maps exactly. The quotient-map criterion and coinduced-domain criterion prove both continuity directions for pointHomeomorph. The topology definition uses neither Filled nor compactHomeomorph.

obligations.name: Exact algebraic inverse charts and overlap domains
obligations.required_input: Actual complex charts must have the two original algebraic evaluation maps as inverses, including both origins.
obligations.constructed_input: pointChart lifts the independent sphere charts along pointHomeomorph. finite_pointChart_symm and infinity_pointChart_symm identify the inverses with chartPoint 1 and chartPoint 0 for every complex coordinate.
obligations.justification: Both chart targets remain the whole complex plane. point_transition cancels the exact homeomorphism in both directions, retaining the independent reciprocal overlap. Thus the manifold is identified with actual algebraic evaluations rather than an unidentified transported atlas.

obligations.name: Full target analytic-manifold construction
obligations.required_input: The exact existing topology and all scheme-valued points must admit compatible analytic charts.
obligations.constructed_input: pointChartedSpace uses the finite chart at every finite point and reciprocal chart at infinity; point_isManifold proves analytic groupoid compatibility.
obligations.justification: Source membership and atlas membership follow through the actual bijective pointHomeomorph. The copied sphere compatibility theorem applies on the exact lifted transitions, with no freeness, smoothness or local-inverse assertion inferred from topology alone.

obligations.name: Exact sphere analytic equivalence
obligations.required_input: Both directions of the previously proved point homeomorphism must be analytic for these particular charts.
obligations.constructed_input: point_contMDiff and point_symm_contMDiff reduce the exact maps to the same chosen-chart cancellation germs; pointBiholomorph retains pointHomeomorph.toEquiv.
obligations.justification: chart_cancel_analytic applies only at a point in the open chart target and uses the partial inverse there. The source and target chart expressions are explicit. No globally valid cancellation of a partial chart or alternate equivalence is assumed.

obligations.name: Original compact modular consumer and cusp assignment
obligations.required_input: The actual compact source and its original parameter must map to the same scheme-valued target points on every original point and both cusps.
obligations.constructed_input: compactPointHomeomorph composes the unchanged compactHomeomorph with pointHomeomorph. Its original-point formula is chartPoint 1 at quotientParameter; infinity and zero cusps are chartPoint 0 at zero and chartPoint 1 at zero.
obligations.justification: The three exact evaluation identities consume compactHomeomorph_original, compactHomeomorph_infinity and compactHomeomorph_zero. Diffeomorph.trans composes the exact previously specified maps, so compactPointBiholomorph_apply equals this same homeomorphism. The source atlas still has the independent original quotient and genuine q-disc germ criteria. No arithmetic descent or j-map compatibility is concluded.

obligations.name: Verification, history and boundaries
obligations.required_input: Copied sources must remain identifiable, all changed applications need hosted kernel checks and distinct review, and arithmetic claims must remain bounded.
obligations.constructed_input: A 44-source revised closure with 41 unchanged sources and three constructor-local instance repairs. Exact prior failure evidence is preserved.
obligations.justification: The previous hosted run 42572007531 at commit 48530f6 passed the first 36 individual source checks, then failed at the compactBiholomorph record because its source ChartedSpace instance was not installed in the definition body. The revision installs exactly the instances already specified in the types, returning the same equivalence and analytic proofs; the two analogous later point constructors are repaired as well. No failed stage bytes are changed, no full recursive audit or whole-packet pass is claimed, and all arithmetic boundaries remain unchanged. Revision after hosted failure: The field-point chart factorization timed out deterministically at 600000 heartbeats. Only the every_point_in_chart theorem receives a bounded 4000000-heartbeat budget; its statement and proof terms are unchanged. The first 38 modules passed the preceding run, including compactBiholomorph and global holomorphy. This is a resource-budget repair, not a new mathematical assertion or evidence that the theorem now elaborates.
